text:
Jules: Dropping a compact 'quickstrike' decision card for the field — one pager that sales can hand to CISOs and infra leads. Focus: security, SLA buckets, and short deploy-mode guidance (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Link: internal doc -> https://docs.google.com/qs-decision-card
Priyanka: Love the hook. Can we lead with a 30s exec line that resonates with procurement + platform? e.g., 'Pick the deploy mode that matches your risk, volume, and latency needs.' Keep it punchy.
Marco: Add a tiny tradeoff matrix: Latency | Cost predictability | Data control. One short phrase per cell so it fits a slide.
Aileen: Include three clear customer signals under the matrix: 1) Pilot / POC -> Hosted, 2) Contracted throughput -> Dedicated, 3) Regulated / air-gapped -> Private. One line each.
sre-bot: Note: recommended minor ops snippet included for failover and canary examples.
Jules: Benchmarks: can someone flatten two workload callouts into one-line bullets? I have ecomm pilot (~8k msgs/day) and regulated finance (~45k msgs/day). Need p95 short-chat latencies and a ballpark $/1k-token delta per mode.
Marco: Pasted numbers into doc: "Ecomm pilot (8k/day): p95 ~140ms on Hosted; Dedicated ~+25% unit cost; Private ~+70% (varies). Regulated finance (45k/day): p95 ~240ms on Hosted; Dedicated ~+20% with optimized batching; Private depends on infra."
Priyanka: Nice. Procurement will like a single-line delta instead of full pricing. Keep 'varies' for Private.
Aileen: Compliance bullets: SOC2 Type II, Customer-managed KMS, optional HSM integration, and audit-log retention choices. Phrase for buyers, no legalese.
Jules: Ops snippet for failover (paste-friendly YAML) — Marco, can you format?
Marco: Sure. Use this short config for the slide:
```yaml
failover:
  primary_pool: us-west-1
  fallback_pool: us-east-2
canary:
  percent: 10
  monitor: 15m
  fallback_on_error: true
```
Priyanka: Reword fallback as 'near-identical SLA on fallback where supported' to avoid absolutes. Add an escalation path line: 'Support P1 target: 1hr; dedicated account escalation available.'
Aileen: Add a 3-bullet webinar landing copy: 1) 'Which deploy mode fits your risk profile', 2) 'Live failover demo + benchmarks', 3) 'How to qualify for a Dedicated trial'. For registration page, shorten to two bullets.
Jules: Also include a tiny 'sales qualification' checkbox area: min monthly tokens, data residency required, preferred SLAs. Makes it easy to hand off to Solutions.
Marco: I'll export a lead-tagging CSV template for SalesOps with headers: email,company,deploy_interest,compliance_flag,monthly_token_estimate. Will attach to the doc.
sre-bot: Reminder: attach mock timeline graphic for the failover demo (ops will supply PNG).
Priyanka: Tone checks: soften any guarantees to 'target SLA' and avoid 'guarantee' wording. Compliance sign-off will remove legal phrasing.
Aileen: CTA: 'Book a 20-min field demo' + a short qualification line: 'Qualification: >50k tokens/month or security requirement met.' Keep it optional.
Jules: Timeline: need final PDF by Friday 09:00 for webinar promo. Who can lock copy by Thu EOD?
Marco: I'll finalize the bench lines and export the CSV by Thu 3pm.
Priyanka: I'll do the compliance sweep and host script by Thu 6pm.
Aileen: I'll tidy the sales checklist and the short landing blurb by Thu 5pm.
Jules: Thanks team — I'll merge changes and post the final PDF Thursday night. :sparkles:
sre-bot: Note: linked doc updated by Marco 4 minutes ago
